_doc: Measured, not inferred: which gates go red when a NAMED design defect is deliberately introduced. Produced by scripts/audit-design-teeth.mjs against a sandbox copy of the repo — the working tree is never written. UNCAUGHT and UNEXERCISED are review queues, not verdicts of worthlessness.

check-contrast.mjs.job: locks the section-rhythm token palette to site.css

check-dark-contrast.mjs.job: keeps the generated dark ramp AA at token level

check-stone-2-usage.mjs.job: counts uses of a tone documented as failing AAA as body text

check-css-drift.mjs.job: hardcoded-hex debt tracker; UNWIRED and documented as FAILING

check-css-shells.mjs.job: guards the per-page CSS shell injection

check-image-formats.mjs.job: AVIF/WebP sibling policy (warn tier in check-all)

check-lazy-images.mjs.job: LCP guard — below-fold must be lazy + async

check-og-images.mjs.why: resolves og:image to brand/*.png, which the sandbox excludes

check-article-graphics.mjs.job: the 9-rule article figure gate (viz-* families, audio-alt, figcaption)

results.why: An off-token hex literal in a shipped stylesheet. This is the defect check-no-offspine-color.mjs was named by the loop charter to catch and never existed to catch.
A hardcoded fill/stroke in an SVG presentation attribute — the illustration drift a stylesheet-only scanner never sees.
A colour literal in a style="" attribute — off-spine colour that no stylesheet audit reaches.
A font-size off the declared scale. A type system with 134 distinct sizes is not a scale, and a gate that cannot see the 135th is not guarding one.
Padding, margin and gap drawn from nowhere — the spacing form of the same defect.
A seventh typeface. Typeface count is the coarsest coherence read there is and it should still be sensitive to one new face.
Delete every tabular-nums rule in every stylesheet. This company prints money a CPA aligns in a column; if that silently stops, the product looks like it guesses.

The SAME defect confined to one stylesheet. This mutation exists to characterise a known blind spot, not to pass: numeric cells are reached by selectors in several sheets at once, so coverage is redundant and losing one sheet leaves uncoveredNumericCells unmoved while the declaration COUNT still falls. Worth knowing which of the two numbers is doing the work.
Delete a colour token's dark redefinition everywhere it is defined. Light keeps its value, dark silently inherits it, and the theme stops being a theme.
A token whose ONLY definition lives inside a dark block — the classic broken-dark-mode bug, invisible in light mode and therefore invisible to most reviewers.
Forty kilobytes of dead CSS. Weight is the one measure where regression is invisible to the eye and obvious to the network.
Break a <!-- count: --> sentinel closer. A broken sentinel silently breaks the gate that reads it — the bar here is ZERO, not "no worse".
One member page loses its stylesheet links — the design never reached this page. Half of the failure that let a specimen ship to /about/ while 1,326 pages disagreed and CI stayed green.

One member page gains a body class and a stylesheet none of its siblings carry — the design reached ONLY this page. The other half, and the one a diff review never catches because the diff looks like progress.
A page truncated to a stub. Deleting content removes hex literals and px font-sizes, so without a measure for this, DELETION reads as design improvement.
A page-level <style> block full of raw hex. Token discipline is recorded per archetype and going UP is the regression.
A grey-on-grey text pairing at roughly 1.3:1. accessibility.html publishes a WCAG 2.2 AA conformance target; an instrument that cannot see this cannot support that sentence.
outline:none on an interactive selector with no :focus-visible restoration — a keyboard user loses the ring and nothing on screen says so.
An animation no prefers-reduced-motion block neutralises. Motion-safe is ADR-004 doctrine in the product repo and unmeasured on the storefront.

An loses width/height — the CLS defect check-image-dimensions.mjs is wired into check-all to guard. This is the control: a defect an EXISTING gate should catch, proving the harness can tell a caught defect from an uncaught one.

Strip loading="lazy" from EVERY page that has it. The maximal form of the LCP defect check-lazy-images.mjs is wired into check-all to guard. If the gate still exits 0 after this, it is not narrow — it is vacuous on this corpus, and its green is the appearance of protection rather than protection.
